issues.problem: Persian rows are ~52px pitch vs 41px in the original (default line-height of Vazirmatn on 13.5/11px text without FA_LH control). The last list item now ends ~17px from the panel bottom edge (y~808 vs panel bottom 825 at f100), breaking the intended 26px padding and the airy bottom of the original; at f38 it nearly touches the edge.
issues.suggestedFix: Set an explicit lineHeight (~1.3-1.35) on title/sub lines or trim marginTop (13.5 -> ~9) so the list ends with at least 26px padding, like the original which left ~100px empty.

issues.where: HubPanel / FrontPanel tabs, subtitles, filters (raw fontSize 10.5-13.5 without fs()/faText)
issues.problem: Most list/filter/tab texts skip faText/fs(), so the 1.1x Persian size compensation and FA_LH are not applied; 11px Persian sublines and 12px tabs are small/low-contrast and hard to read in the 1920x1080 frame.
issues.suggestedFix: Wrap these in faText(px) (or fs()) and re-measure the layout; keep within panel bounds.

issues.problem: The map composition (Figma/GitHub left, Salesforce top, GDrive/Dropbox right, neon rectangles, pulse direction icon->hub) is deliberately left unmirrored; this is defensible (radial network, physical flow) but the justification for the left/right placement of brand tiles relative to a now right-weighted panel is thin, and the composition visually reads LTR-weighted around an RTL panel.
issues.suggestedFix: Either document explicitly why the map is not flipped (symmetric radial hub, brand marks, flow physical) or mirror tile/pipe x positions with W-x and flip pulse accordingly.

issues.where: LIST titles 'حساب سازمانی بزرگ - بریتانیا' and 'سرنخ سازمانی باز - پیگیری'
issues.problem: ASCII hyphen used as separator; Persian typography prefers an en dash with spaces.

notes: Verified by own harness render at f0,10,14,18,21,23,28,38,45,49,52,55,62,66,71,100,125,149. Diff vs original (CRLF-stripped) shows only text, direction:rtl, border-left->border-right, FaRoot wrapper and font removal: all timings, exports, seeds, easing, flip, pipes, tiles unchanged. Persian shaping is correct everywhere (joined letters, ZWNJ in بسته‌شده/پایپ‌لاین/وایت‌بردها, Latin tokens MQL/Figma/GDrive/ClickUp render in sensible positions, '(MQL)' parens correct), no letterSpacing/uppercase, ی/ک correct, Vazirmatn actually loaded and fits restrained product UI. Panel mirroring is correct: list on the right, filter rail on the left with separator on the correct side, old page title/marker/chips and gray text bars right-aligned. Mid-flip (f21 edge-on bloom, f28) renders back face correctly with no clipping apart from perspective crop. No raster text, no cheating (nothing blurred or hidden). Only one comp exists. Remaining weaknesses are vertical crowding of the list and unscaled small text; otherwise close to shippable.
